pairs.l: 2 — couldn't cope with the adrenaline rush?
4 — was too frightened to try the sport?
5 — did not have his parents' permission?
11 — wishes he had done the sport?
12 — has to take a break from the sport?

r1.exp: 1=E (Ethan: 'very soon I was riding Nu-skool'). 2=B (Benjamin: 'just too much excitement for me. Once and never again.'). 3=A (Adam: 'I felt uneasy at first'). 4=F (Finley: 'quite enough for me to ride an ordinary bike'). 5=F (Finley: 'My parents would never have allowed it'). 6=D (Daniel: 'they never asked me to join in'). 7=C (Connor: 'parents generally disapproved of spending money on extreme sports'). 8=F (Finley: 'I always go to watch him'). 9=C (Connor: 'won the club cup last year'). 10=B (Benjamin: 'attracted me was the thought of the danger'). 11=D (Daniel: 'I'm sure I would have been able to do it'). 12=E (Ethan: 'having to watch it on TV until I recover').

r13.exp: 'I suppose it's just that I've GOT USED TO IT after all this time' = navika = C (out of habit).

r14.exp: 'Some simply like to WATCH the capital's inhabitants... I'm definitely one of the FORMER' → 'former' refers to watching people = B (observing other people).

r15.exp: 'Consumption of snacks such as burgers to be the MOST ANTI-SOCIAL practice' = jelo = D (Eating).

r16.exp: Priča pokazuje da je djevojka htjela pomoći ali je uvrijedila starca — pazi da ne uvrijediš ljude = A (be careful not to offend people).

r17.exp: 'A DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTIC of our transport system' = posebnost = A (a special feature).

r18.exp: Cijeli tekst je osobni doživljaj autorice na podzemnoj željeznici — to je osobni prikaz = B (personal view).

r19.exp: 'Show women can do same as men. (19)___. We've been lucky, companies sponsor us.' → B: another aim = raising money for charity. Sponzori su relevantni za dobrotvornu svrhu.

r20.exp: 'Need to be physically prepared... (20)___. Pull heavy loads, good skiers.' → A: good athletes and training for a long time. Logičan nastavak o fizičkoj pripremi.

r21.exp: 'Stand up to the severe polar environment. (21)___. First of all, freezing temperatures, storms...' → E: Undoubtedly, it is one of the most challenging in the world. Uvod u popis opasnosti.

r22.exp: 'If you sweat, it might freeze. (22)___. There's the risk of frostbite...' → G: that's not the only physical danger. Prijelaz na sljedeću opasnost (smrzotine).

r23.exp: 'Need enough food. (23)___. We get over this by dehydrating it.' → H: The problem is how we are going to carry it all. Problem nošenja → rješenje: dehidracija hrane.

r24.exp: 'In contact with outside world in case of problem. (24)___. One call and we can be airlifted out.' → F: If we're in serious trouble, then we can obviously get help. Kontakt = mogućnost evakuacije.

r25.exp: 'To fertilise OTHER plants or flowers' — 'other' uz množinu imenice bez člana. 'Another' bi išlo uz jedninu.

r26.exp: 'It AFFECTS up to one in five people' — 'affect' (glagol) = utječe na. 'Effect' je imenica, 'influence' = utjecati na (moguće ali 'affect' je preciznije za medicinska stanja).

r27.exp: 'First develops DURING the teenage years' — 'during' uz imeničku frazu (the teenage years). 'When/while' idu uz surečenice.

r28.exp: 'If you ALREADY have asthma' = ako već imate astmu. 'Already' uz present simple za postojeće stanje.

r29.exp: 'INTERFERE with school or work' — fiksna kolokacija: interfere with = ometati, smetati (u negativnom smislu za aktivnosti).

r30.exp: 'LOSS of concentration' — fiksna kolokacija: loss of concentration (gubitak koncentracije). 'Shortage' = nedostatak resursa.

r31.exp: 'Stay inside as MUCH as possible' — fiksni izraz: as much as possible = što je više moguće. 'Much' uz nebrojivu/apstraktnu imenicu (količinu vremena).

r32.exp: 'Stay inside... (32)____, avoid parks.' → A: THEREFORE (stoga, dakle). Logičan zaključak: ostani unutra, DAKLE izbjegavaj parkove.

r33.exp: 'Present their speculations AS IF they were indisputable facts' — fiksni izraz: as if = kao da.

r34.exp: 'Know FOR certain' — fiksni izraz: know for certain / for sure = znati sigurno.

r35.exp: 'Furthered by the Christian church FOR historical reasons' — prijedlog 'for' uz razlog.

r36.exp: 'Rested ON the seventh (day)' — prijedlog 'on' uz redni broj koji označava dan.

r37.exp: 'Well KNOWN to the ancient inhabitants' — fiksna kolokacija: well known (dobro poznat).

r38.exp: 'There are some theories AS WELL' — fiksni izraz: as well = također (na kraju rečenice).

r39.exp: 'No record of... ever HAVING been broken' — perfektni gerund u pasivnoj konstrukciji: (ever) having been.

r40.exp: 'At LEAST since the days of Moses' — fiksni izraz: at least = barem.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi s uvodom, razradom i zaključkom. Argumenti ZA: iskustvo iz prve ruke, upoznavanje kultura, razvoj neovisnosti. Argumenti PROTIV: škola daje sustavno znanje, teorijsku osnovu, strukturu. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej zadatak — ručno se ocjenjuje. Kriteriji: sadržaj (argumenti za i protiv + vlastito mišljenje), organizacija (uvod/razrada/zaključak), jezik (viša razina, bogatiji vokabular, složenije strukture), dužina 200–250 riječi.
